title: Act: Add MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH and the n / max counter
summary: Export the constant and render the counter in ContributionSheet
description: Add MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH = 500 to the API client and render a counter derived from the trimmed text length in ContributionSheet.
acceptance_criteria: Counter reads 'n / 500' for the trimmed text length
Textarea aria-describedby includes the counter id

steps.action: Add an exported constant MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH with value 500 directly below MAX_PER_PLAYER
Import MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH from '../api/client' in the existing import on L2, then after the 'remaining' const on L67 add const length = Array.from(text.trim()).length;
steps.expected: length holds the trimmed character count on every render

steps.action:
After the textarea add

{`${length} / ${MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH}`}

; change aria-describedby on the textarea to join the ids 'contribution-idea-count' and, when validation is set, 'contribution-idea-error' with a space
steps.expected: Counter text is visible and referenced by the textarea
